arrival_burst.mechanism: Arrival bursts may overload triage before an incident is assigned.
arrival_burst.leakage_risk: Exclude simultaneous/current arrivals with left-open search.
arrival_burst.falsification: No positive paired PR-AUC delta and no Top-5% recall gain.

active_workload.mechanism: Open workload at arrival may proxy queue pressure.
active_workload.availability: Uses prior incidents and whether each had ended by scoring time.
active_workload.leakage_risk: Outcome timestamps only determine prior incident state; never current outcome.
active_workload.falsification: No temporal gain or instability caused by closure-coverage regime.

recurrence.mechanism: Rapid recurrence can identify correlated operational episodes.
recurrence.availability: Prior openings for the same safe key only.
recurrence.leakage_risk: No future/current row in cumulative support.

novelty_support.mechanism: Rare or first-seen classifications may be harder to resolve inside OLA.
novelty_support.falsification: Ablation is neutral/negative across paired folds.

historical_outcomes.mechanism: Previously resolved patterns may carry persistent OLA risk.
historical_outcomes.availability: Only outcomes known before each new opening.
historical_outcomes.leakage_risk: Strict known-time event ordering and smoothing.
historical_outcomes.falsification: No operational lift after point-in-time restriction.

config_identity.mechanism: Configuration-item identity/frequency may expose fragile assets.
config_identity.availability: Value known at opening; mappings fitted inside each fold.
config_identity.falsification: Temporal PR-AUC fails to improve or fold variance increases materially.

description_history.mechanism: Exact alert summaries may recur with consistent operational risk.
description_history.availability: Opening text identity; no text leaves memory.
description_history.leakage_risk: Rare exact strings and sensitive content; only encoded aggregates retained.
description_history.falsification: No paired gain or only one-fold win.

interactions.mechanism: Supported classification combinations may be more informative than marginal levels.
interactions.availability: Opening values; encoders trained per fold.
interactions.leakage_risk: Sparse combinations; smoothing and unknown buckets required.

calendar_context.mechanism: Minute, shift boundary and holiday proximity may proxy coverage constraints.

segmented_bursts.mechanism: Local bursts within product/priority may matter more than global volume.
segmented_bursts.falsification: No gain over global burst features.

queue_growth.mechanism: Acceleration in arrivals and net open-queue growth may precede violations.
queue_growth.leakage_risk: End events included only when they occurred before scoring.

text_tfidf.mechanism: Fold-fitted lexical patterns may generalize beyond exact description identity.
text_tfidf.availability: Opening text; vocabulary fitted on training rows only.
text_tfidf.leakage_risk: Sensitive tokens never persisted; vocabulary never reported.
text_tfidf.falsification: Blended ranking does not improve paired PR-AUC and Top-5% recall.
